comments.content: Breaking out of the loop as soon as `highest_key_score + remaining_votes < quorum_threshold()` is no longer safe: `remaining_votes` is decremented for every response, including responses that are not yet counted in `highest_key_score` (e.g. errors or values for a different key). If the current highest key is not the one that will eventually reach quorum, this condition can become true prematurely and abort the communication before a quorum is actually reached. The previous code only set `end_time` and still allowed the loop to continue until the timeout, so this is a behavioral regression. Consider restoring the previous behavior or only breaking when no key can possibly reach quorum.
